what_happened: On a clear multi-lane highway with nothing close ahead, the policy braked hard for no reason (20.3 to 8.0 m/s) and drifted about 1.2 m left of the recorded path, toward the line with the left lane. Actor 1, a replayed car in the left lane, kept the recorded human speed and came up alongside and past the slowing ego, so the ego's front-left corner hit it (it was likely also rear-ended because of the sudden braking).

The ego was driving straight in its lane at about 8.5 m/s when actor 24 came up from behind on the right, drew alongside, and cut over the lane line into the ego's right front at 9.2 s. The ego stayed within about 0.6 m of the recorded path, but it was about 20 m behind where the recorded car was, so the replayed actor merged into space the ego was still occupying.

The rear-end contact recorded in this run fits the ego's unnecessary hard braking.

Vehicle 1 was alongside and slightly ahead, and the ego's front-left corner ran into it. Rear contact is also flagged for the run, likely from the hard braking, but the front collision came first.
